PullRequest.Title: copilot: remove simulation caches and flags that no stest uses
PullRequest.Body:

Follow-up to #345187.

This removes simulator infrastructure that none of the 130 remaining stest scenarios uses: SQLite caches for the embeddings, docs-search and chunking services, a simulated GitHub code search, two simulator flags that no longer change any result, and cache salts and scopes that nothing reads. Simulation results don't change: the CI suite still replays the same 130 scenarios with an unchanged score.

**12 files changed (10 insertions, 592 deletions).** 88% of the deleted lines date from the June 2025 import. Most of the rest are edits that had to follow changes to the services these caches wrap.

## How I know these are unused
- A V8 coverage run of `simulate-ci`, mapped back to sources with c8: the docs-search client, chunking client and workspace chunk search service are never constructed, and the embeddings computer is constructed but never called.
- The recorded cache in `test/simulation/cache` holds only chat requests (1,321), diagnostics resources (141) and model metadata (2). It has no embeddings, docs-search or chunking entries.
- `--use-experimental-code-search-service` only swaps the workspace chunk search service, which no scenario constructs. `--summarize-history` sets the agent history summarization setting, but no scenario runs agent mode, and the flag defaulted to `true`, the same as the setting.
- These files still cost maintenance: 14 commits in 2026 edited them, almost all to keep up with changes to the services they wrap (code search and external ingest, networking, OpenTelemetry).

## What's removed
**Commit 1: unused simulation caches**
- `CachingEmbeddingsComputer`, `CachingCodeOrDocSearchClient` and `CachingChunkingEndpointClient`, their SQLite caches, and the docs-search throttling wrapper. The simulator now registers `RemoteEmbeddingsComputer`, `DocsSearchClient` and `ChunkingEndpointClientImpl`, as it already did with `--skip-cache`, except that docs search no longer goes through the throttler, which sent one request per second. The embeddings index settings are unchanged: the remote index cache is still used only with `--skip-cache`.
- Their cache salts (`embeddingsCacheSalt`, `codeSearchCacheSalt`, `chunksEndpointCacheSalt`, `CODE_SEARCH_CACHE_SALT` and `CHUNKING_ENDPOINT_CACHE_SALT`).
- Cache salts and scopes that nothing read: `globalStateSalt`, `globalStorageSalt`, `notebookCacheSalt`, `docSearchCacheSalt` and `globalStateCacheSalt`, and the `Embeddings`, `Notebook`, `DocSearch`, `CodeSearch` and `Chunks` cache scopes.

**Commit 2: simulated code search and two no-op flags**
- `SimulationCodeSearchChunkSearchService` (`simuliationWorkspaceChunkSearch.ts`) and `--use-experimental-code-search-service`.
- `--summarize-history`.

## What stays: the completions cache
An earlier version of this PR also removed `CachingCompletionsFetchService`. As the review pointed out, it isn't only a cache: it's also where `--no-fetch` and `--require-cache` apply to completions requests, and where those requests are recorded for the simulation workbench. The removed caches did neither; on a miss they called the live service. Nothing in the simulator calls the completions service today (its only product consumer is ghost-text completions, which no stest runs), but the flags' guarantees shouldn't depend on that, and a future ghost-text stest would need recorded responses to pass in CI. So it stays, unchanged.

I checked this with a temporary stest that makes one completions request to an `.invalid` host:

| | `--require-cache` | `--no-fetch` |
|---|---|---|
| This PR | Run stops on the cache miss, no request made | Empty response, no request made, request recorded in `sim-requests.txt` |
| Without the completions cache | Request made (fails with a fetch error) | Request made (fails with a fetch error), nothing recorded |

## Behavior changes
- A future stest that needs embeddings, docs search or chunking would call the real service until someone adds a cache. CI has no token, so such a test would fail there rather than silently pass.
- `--use-experimental-code-search-service` and `--summarize-history` are no longer read. Passing them has no effect.

## Open PRs and branches
#323168 is the only one of the 3,061 open PRs that touches these files. It edits a different part of `simulationOptions.ts` and merges without conflicts. None of the recently pushed NES, ghost-text, code-search or simulation branches has its own commits on the deleted files.

## Validation
- `npm run typecheck` (all 4 projects) passes at both commits. ESLint on the 6 touched source files and `git diff --check` are clean.
- No export became unreferenced, except `parseGithubCodeSearchResponse`, which is still used in its own product file. I left it exported so this PR only touches test code.
- With the simulator built, `node dist/simulationMain.js --ci --require-cache` reports "Score unchanged in 130 scenarios" (overall score 90.25%).
- The coverage run on the final commits shows no scenario makes a network call through the replaced services: `RemoteEmbeddingsComputer` is constructed but never called, and `DocsSearchClient`, `ChunkingEndpointClientImpl` and `WorkspaceChunkSearchService` are never constructed.
- External NES scenarios (`--external-scenarios=test/simulation/fixtures/inlineEdits --nes=external --require-cache --n=1`) build the same model request as before: the run stops at the same test with the same request hash.
- `--help` no longer lists the removed flags, and `--list-tests` still lists all 130 tests when they're passed.
- `npx vitest run --changed origin/main`: 96 test files passed (2,136 tests), 3 skipped.
- Not run: the simulation workbench, whose code didn't change and which passes neither removed flag.

🤖 Authored with GitHub Copilot on behalf of @alexdima.

Scenarios.Scenario: Current repository simulation CI suite and visualization-runner execution
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Each test run creates a simulation service collection, runs the scenario, writes its request/log artifacts, and disposes the collection. The changed embeddings, docs-search, chunking, and workspace-search registrations are lazy descriptors; no changed remote call must complete for the checked repository scenarios to progress.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Initialize the simulation SQLite cache singleton and query embeddings/docs/chunks entries
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero on current scenarios because none calls the removed wrappers; constructing SQLiteCache only sets a namespace.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The deleted wrapper objects existed per run but deferred all filesystem/database work until get/set.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Not on the current scenario critical path before or after the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Default-cache mode would first query SQLite and call the same remote operation only on a miss; skip-cache mode already used the direct client.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: No effect because no checked scenario invokes the service.

ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Default-cache mode would first query SQLite and call this boundary only on a miss; skip-cache mode already used the direct client.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: No effect because no checked scenario invokes the service.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero; repository search found registrations and implementation but no product or test consumer.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: If called, requests passed through a one-per-second throttler and default-cache mode also queried SQLite first.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The repository suite's scenario/run count, scheduled through TaskRunner with default parallelism 20. Effective changed-service call cardinality is zero for the checked scenarios; service registration occurs once per test run.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: TaskRunner bounds concurrent test runs at the configured parallelism (default 20). Because the changed services are not invoked by current scenarios, their effective network concurrency is zero.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Chat, completions, resource, and model-metadata caches are unchanged. Before the diff, three deleted SQLite wrapper objects were created for default-cache runs, but their constructors only stored namespaces and did not initialize Cache.Instance or open SQLite; actual cache reads were lazy. After the diff, direct clients are registered lazily. Thus cold and warm current runs perform no changed cache read or remote fallback.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that startup/CI registration itself adds no boundary work: SyncDescriptor registrations are lazy and SQLiteCache constructors do not touch Cache.Instance.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Dynamic external scenarios are not enumerable from repository content, but the checked in-repository consumers and scenarios establish zero changed-service calls for the maintained suite.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff removes dormant cache plumbing without adding work to the maintained CI or visualization critical paths.

Scenarios.Scenario: External or future simulation invoking FetchWebPage URL ranking
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After the internal page fetch, FetchWebPageTool waits for UrlChunkEmbeddingsIndex.findInUrls, which waits for one query-embedding computation and chunking/embedding results for each valid text URL before rendering the tool result.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One embedding call per ranking invocation, internally batched by RemoteEmbeddingsComputer; zero for maintained repository scenarios.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: A persistent SQLite hit could avoid the network call; misses already used the same remote client.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: If an external scenario invokes the tool, ranking waits for this call.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Chunk and embed fetched page content
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Up to one request per valid URL not present in the per-instance memory cache; zero for maintained repository scenarios.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: A persistent SQLite hit by full-content hash could avoid the request across runs; misses already used the same endpoint.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: If reached, Promise.all waits for every URL's result before ranking continues.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch page content through the VS Code internal tool
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One internal-tool invocation carrying the URL list, unchanged by this diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Completes before changed ranking work begins.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of valid text URLs per tool invocation and repeated simulation runs. After the diff, a cold invocation performs one query-embedding operation plus up to one chunk request per uncached URL; batches and endpoint limiters determine actual request count/concurrency.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Per invocation, the query embedding and all URL chunk work start through Promise.all; URL chunk requests are additionally governed by ChunkingEndpointClientImpl's request limiter. Across simulation runs, TaskRunner may run up to configured parallelism, with separate service instances.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Before the diff, persistent SQLite caches could serve query embeddings and full-content chunk responses across test runs, with remote fallback on misses. After the diff, UrlChunkEmbeddingsIndex retains chunks only in memory for one service lifetime; query embeddings are not persisted. Cold behavior remains remote, while cross-run warm behavior would become remote again.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High for the cache-miss mechanism if such a scenario is added, but low that it is reachable in the reviewed product scenarios today.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Arbitrary external scenarios may invoke this path, but repository search found no maintained simulation scenario or fixture that invokes FetchWebPage or these embedding/chunk methods. Future workload size is therefore unknown.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding. Removing persistence would increase warm-run network work for a future/external FetchWebPage scenario, but the reviewed repository provides no current realistic trigger; reporting it would be hypothetical rather than a diff-introduced regression on an established path.

Scenarios.Scenario: Legacy explicit simulation flags for experimental code search and history summarization
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The removed code-search flag formerly selected a localhost-backed workspace search implementation; without it, codebase search uses WorkspaceChunkSearchService and may initialize embedding/index services when a scenario actually requests codebase search. The removed summarization option formerly overrode a configuration whose default is already true; current non-agent scenarios do not enter history summarization.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Perform workspace/code search or initialize remote embedding/index state
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero for maintained scenarios; only an explicit legacy flag combined with an actual codebase search could distinguish old and new implementations.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: With the removed explicit flag, the simulation implementation issued one localhost POST per semantic search; default behavior already used WorkspaceChunkSearchService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Not on current scenario paths. If reached externally, search waits for initialization and search boundaries.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Summarize long agent conversation history through the chat/model path
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero for maintained scenarios because they do not run the affected agent mode; default-true behavior is unchanged.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The CLI override defaulted to true, matching the configuration default. Only an undocumented false override could have disabled this work.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of codebase-search tool calls, workspace/repository size, and long agent-history turns. Effective cardinality is zero because no maintained scenario uses the removed code-search option or runs the affected agent-history mode.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No effective concurrency in maintained scenarios. If an arbitrary external scenario used these paths, concurrency would be governed by that scenario's tool calls, endpoint limiters, and the simulation TaskRunner rather than by new scheduling in this diff.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Workspace search owns its existing index/cache behavior; the removed simulated search had no added cache. Summarization uses unchanged chat caching. No maintained warm/cold behavior changes because neither removed override is exercised.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that default maintained behavior is unchanged; low that legacy explicit arguments represent an active performance-critical scenario.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Arbitrary users could still pass removed minimist arguments, but no maintained scenario, help-supported false mode, or checked caller establishes a realistic current workload.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The removed flags do not alter work on current scenarios, and hypothetical legacy/external uses lack the realistic trigger required for a finding.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance review of all 12 changed files and all diff pages. Traced cache lifecycle, lazy service construction, simulation concurrency, and transitive filesystem/network boundaries. No high-confidence performance regression is introduced on a maintained scenario, and the diff does not establish a concrete shipped regression fix requiring report_regression_fix.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
